title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (w/no Dolby) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 2x Nakamichi CM300's with CP4 shotguns (L R), plus 1x Nakamichi CM300 with CP1 cardioid (blend mic) > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S 90's. Mics on stand, set up in center right section riser, just off the floor.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a high‑energy 9/18/82 Garden show with a Jack Straw → Sugaree opener, scorching West L.A., Dupree’s Diamond run, superb Set II and a mellow Baby Blue encore.
ai_review.review: The three fan reviews agree that this AUD tape delivers crystal‑clear vocals and instrument balance despite the notoriously tough acoustics of the old Garden, making it sound almost as good as a soundboard. Musically the concert is described as “high energy from start to finish,” highlighted by the Jack Straw > Sugaree opening, a fiery West L.A., three‑night Dupree’s run, and a superb second set capped by U.B. Jesus and Baby Blue. Overall it’s a standout night from the celebrated 1982 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (5, 5, 4) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and audio quality indicate a top‑tier show with an excellent audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocal presence (Jerry's voice praised), good instrument separation, surprisingly clean for the Garden venue; no reported dropouts or major noise issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, cohesive flow with a tight first set and a superb second set that builds to an uplifting encore; the show feels well‑balanced and consistently energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice sounds particularly good and his playing is described as fantastic.
band_member_comments.Bob: Dedicated ‘Samson’ to the building, showing his connection with the venue.
